scoping_law.spec_mandate: N17: official NIST ML-DSA-65 vectors vs signer (vendored ACVP subset per E33)
scoping_law.delivered: PIPELINE-KAT, clearly labeled NOT official-ACVP. The official NIST ACVP ML-DSA-65 corpus is not available offline in this lane's environment; no network fetch at test time. Vectors are self-described frozen records (seed -> pk -> deterministic signature) of the signer's documented pipeline, pinned at lane time (2026-10-12) and re-asserted bit-for-bit on every run. Upgrade path to official-ACVP is drop-in: replace the frozen hex with ACVP pk|message|signature triples; no other court logic changes. Difference is stated verbatim in the court header (tests/nato/n17_fips204_kat.rs lines 1-27).

court.domain: ML-DSA-65 (FIPS 204) signer pipeline: 2 frozen KATs (seeds 0x01+j and 0x02+j, j=0..31), fixed 72-byte attested payloads; every verdict asserted against real sign/verify via strata_protocol::signer (Chicago: real keys, no doubles)
